issues.description: The UML diagram inside the problem statement names the class 'Course' while the rest of the exercise (text, template, and solution) refers to the class as 'Lecture'. This naming mismatch in the problem statement can confuse students about which class they should implement and test.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML diagram in the problem statement to use the class name 'Lecture' (instead of 'Course'), ensuring the diagram and textual description consistently refer to the same class. Alternatively, if 'Course' was intended, rename the template/solution class files and references to 'Course' to match the UML.
